item.content:encoded:
News / U.Today / Hoskinson Weighs In on Cardano (ADA) Price Collapse

Hoskinson Weighs In on Cardano (ADA) Price Collapse 2 min read

ADAUSD ADAUSD Charles Hoskinson, founder of Cardano ADAUSD , has tried to clear the air regarding the utility of the cryptocurrency. This comes as ADA has fallen more than 95% from its all-time high. Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson responded to frustrated Cardano community members who are disappointed by the blockchain’s pace of development and inability to rebound from the current slump. Cardano utility vs. ADA price On Nov. 21, Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson took to X to counter criticism about the current state of Cardano. The exchange was triggered by a joke made by an X user stating that Grand Theft Auto 6 came out before a working Cardano blockchain. Hoskinson replied to the comment, saying: “Cardano works.” Later, Hoskinson addressed the poor price performance of the cryptocurrency and explained that price doesn’t always reflect the capabilities of blockchain networks. “Yeah. Price doesn't equal utility. Is Solana 75 percent less capable than it's all time high? It's an infinitely better product today for many more people. And so it is for Cardano,” he said. What this means is that even if the value of a blockchain network's native cryptocurrency is dropping, the technology can still advance. An X user, however, contested his comparison with Solana, stating that Cardano hasn’t been able to retake its previous all-time high even after years of development. This drew an increasingly irritated response from Hoskinson. “So every single thing a f****** scam? Everything they do failed? I’m so tired of you people,” said the Cardano founder. Cardano ADAUSD down 95% from all-time high This recent statement by Hoskinson comes as Cardano ADAUSD remains one of the worst-performing major cryptocurrencies in the current market downturn. As per CoinGlass data, ADA is currently trading at around $0.14. The cryptocurrency is down by about 57% since the beginning of 2026. It has lost a whopping 95.4% of its value from its all-time high of $3.09, set in September 2021. On Nov. 21, ADA briefly dipped toward $0.13. This came as another sell-off hit the broader crypto market. Cardano has been in a steady decline, leading to criticism regarding its adoption, activity in its ecosystem and ability to compete with the likes of Ethereum and Solana. Nonetheless, Charles Hoskinson has maintained that short-term market performance should not be conflated with the progress of blockchain technology over the long run. Earlier this month, the Cardano founder tried to reassure frustrated ADA holders and tell them that things would eventually get better. “It's all going to be ok. Everyone will be happy next year after all this madness, hate and idiocy,” said Hoskinson in a previous X post.

item.content:encoded:
News / U.Today / Shiba Inu Team Makes Key GitHub Clarification for ShibaSwap, Shibarium

Shiba Inu Team Makes Key GitHub Clarification for ShibaSwap, Shibarium 2 min read

SHIBUSD BONEUSD "Shib.io is home to both Shibarium and ShibaSwap," Shiba Inu developer and long-time community member Mazrael said, citing the project’s public Git repository as evidence of the longstanding relationship. Mazrael recently spoke about the link between the official web presence of the Shiba Inu ecosystem and its decentralized platforms in a post, stating that the information has been consistent since the launch of ShibaSwap.

Mazrael.shib @Mazrael_shib

@Heisenbergiqr3 @tacitfi @randhindi @LCSHIB @Shibtoken https://t.co/RP8CH8r1zW is home of Shibarium and Shibaswap as indicated in our public git that has not changed since Shibaswap and is the same git for shibarium

Nov 21, 2026

Mazrael says the public Git repository has not changed since the launch of ShibaSwap and is the same repository that is used for Shibarium. The clarification seems intended to quell confusion on Shiba Inu's official channels as legacy domains become decommissioned. He pointed to the project’s public Git as proof that Shib.io is the home of Shibarium and ShibaSwap. The clarification strengthens the link among Shib.io, ShibaSwap and Shibarium, two key components of the Shiba Inu ecosystem. Mazrael's reference to the unchanged public Git repository also highlights the team's position that this connection is not a recent development but part of the project's established infrastructure. In the latest development for Shibarium, Mazrael announced that CreateX is now live on the Shiba Inu Layer 2. Shiba Inu price rebounds Shiba Inu has climbed back above $0.0000035, recovering from Saturday's low of $0.00000337, its weakest level in years. It’s trading near $0.0000036, up 3.23% in the last 24 hours. The broader crypto market is seeing a short-term rebound, but it does not fully establish that the decline has ended. According to Santiment, “Stablecoin Whale Dry Powder Continues Shrinking Across Crypto.” The largest tracked stablecoin whales are holding far less dry powder than before, Santiment stated, noting that since the start of the year, USDT balances on Ethereum held by the top 100 whales have fallen by $15.14 billion (-21.1%) and USDC (on Ethereum) balances are down $6.72 billion (-23.7%). Stablecoins are crypto’s ready-to-deploy cash, so large whale balances can represent potential buying power for BTC and altcoins. Falling balances can mean funds were deployed, redeemed, transferred elsewhere, or moved outside these tracked wallets. Either way, having less USDT and USDC concentrated among major holders means less obvious dry powder waiting on the sidelines.

item.content:encoded:
News / U.Today / XRP Ledger Loses 60% of Users

XRP Ledger Loses 60% of Users 1 min read

XRPUSD XRP Ledger's network activity has dropped sharply, losing around 60% of the users it had yesterday. The decline comes amid a serious price correction and increased pressure on the cryptocurrency market. Selling pressure remains high, and the declining number of users is not helping the price. Fuel for the correction XRPScan's data showed 250,000 users 24 hours ago, while today's reading shows barely 92,000 users. While the drop is significant, it should not be considered critical on its own. The decline partly reflects a regular weekend slowdown, when traders are generally less active, but it comes alongside the price correction and broader selling pressure.

BITSTAMP:XRPUSDT Chart by TradingView"> The highest point for this metric in November was 300,000, with a monthly average of approximately 200,000 active users. The number of users is a critical metric for the network's health, and a decline toward 100,000 often comes before bullish sentiment among investors. The current drop does not guarantee that sentiment will turn, especially as the price remains under pressure. Price action remains weak Apart from the negative on-chain trend, XRP's price performance has also been weak. The price lost roughly 5% from its November 19 close and even fell below the $0.90 price level, which was expected to serve as a foundation for recovery. XRP was around $0.915 on November 22 after closing at $0.9604 three days earlier. The trend remains bearish, and the decline could become significantly worse. Few expected a surge in market liquidations so soon, as Bitcoin fell below the $60,000 price level. XRP and other altcoins followed the broader market trend and suffered serious losses. Interest in the network appears to be weakening as the price correction continues, so this drop in activity is not helping XRP's recovery. A potential recovery above $0.9 could be the key to a quick rebound. However, the overall trend remains bearish and is unlikely to change unless significant market events occur.
